ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL

To: Client: Acme Corporation
From: Attorney: Sarah Johnson, Esq.
Date: January 30, 2024
Re: Litigation Strategy - Acme v. Beta Corp (Case No. CV-2024-001234)

Dear Client,

This memorandum contains privileged attorney-client communications regarding our litigation strategy.

Plaintiff: Acme Corporation
Defendant: Beta Corporation

Our outside counsel at Johnson & Associates has reviewed the settlement proposal from opposing counsel. We recommend rejecting the current offer of $2.5 million and proceeding with discovery.

Key Points:
1. The Plaintiff has strong evidence of breach of contract
2. Attorney work product indicates potential damages exceed $5 million
3. Counsel recommends deposing Defendant's CFO, Michael Brown

Settlement Strategy:
Our legal counsel advises maintaining litigation hold on all relevant documents. The Attorney believes we have leverage to negotiate a settlement between $4-6 million.

Please contact Attorney Sarah Johnson directly at the law firm to discuss further.

Respectfully,
Sarah Johnson, Esq.
Johnson & Associates, LLP
